title: BiasScanner: Automatic Detection and Classification of News Bias to Strengthen Democracy

bias_targets.methodology: Sentence-level detection and classification of news articles using a fine-tuned large language model (GPT-3.5) evaluated against the BABE dataset. The system categorizes text into 27 fine-grained sub-types of journalistic, cognitive, and logical biases, including Political Bias, Emotional Sensationalism Bias, Discriminatory Bias, Cherry Picking Bias, Ad Hominem Bias, and Word Choice Bias.
